readings.Aries: You function best when there is something to push against. Right now, push gently. This is a better week for listening than speaking.
readings.Taurus: What feels like stability might be stagnation. It is worth sitting with the discomfort of not knowing. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Gemini: The duality you experience is not a disorder — it's wide bandwidth. Channel it deliberately. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Cancer: The person you're worried about knows you're worried. Say it out loud instead. The energy available today is better used gently.
readings.Leo: You are drawn to centre stage even when the wings would give you more information. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Virgo: Something you noticed and catalogued weeks ago is relevant now. Your records are good. You already have what you need to take the next step.
readings.Libra: Other people's approval has weight in your emotional system. Today, your own approval matters more. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Scorpio: The loyalty you give is total. The loyalty you require is reasonable. Don't lower the bar. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Sagittarius: You've been talking about the future in a way that lets you avoid the present. Notice this. The question matters more than the answer right now.
readings.Capricorn: Your standards for yourself are borrowed from somewhere. Examine the source. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Aquarius: You have been right about this for a long time. It is not yet time to say 'I told you so.' Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Pisces: Something that felt like intuition was actually projection. Distinguish between them carefully. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

sky_notes: Saturn appears retrograde today. Earth is overtaking Saturn — an apparent backwards loop that happens every year for ~4.5 months. Plan your timecourse accordingly (or don't).
Uranus appears retrograde today. Uranus spends ~5 months of every year appearing to go backwards because Earth laps it. It's tilted 98°, so it's used to looking odd.
Neptune appears retrograde today. Neptune appears retrograde ~5 months a year as Earth laps it. Light from Neptune takes ~4 hours to reach you, so this news is already old.
First quarter: Moon and Sun are ~90° apart, so exactly half the visible disc is lit. Tides are at their weakest (neap) around now.
Mars and Jupiter are within 0.1° of each other in the sky — a line-of-sight coincidence; in reality they are hundreds of millions of km apart.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: geocentric, from JPL Keplerian elements (Standish, valid 1800–2050) + Meeus ch.25/47 for Sun & Moon; checked against PyEphem to within 0.5°
Positions are for ~midday Sydney time on the stated date (tropical zodiac, equinox of date)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
